name: robust-ai-agent
description: Robust AI coding agent with XML-based communication and specialized NestJS support

scripts.test:connection: npm run build && node -e "const {RobustAIAgent} = require('./dist/robust-ai-agent'); new RobustAIAgent(process.cwd()).testConnection().then(r => console.log('AI Connection:', r ? 'OK' : 'Failed'))"
scripts.test:nestjs: npm run build && node -e "const {NestJSSpecializedAgent} = require('./dist/nestjs-specialized-agent'); new NestJSSpecializedAgent(process.cwd()).testConnection().then(r => console.log('NestJS AI Connection:', r ? 'OK' : 'Failed'))"
scripts.check-types: npm run build && node -e "const {RobustAIAgent} = require('./dist/robust-ai-agent'); const agent = new RobustAIAgent(process.cwd()); agent.initialize().then(() => agent.checkTypes()).then(r => console.log(r))"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build && echo '✅ Robust AI Agent setup complete!'
